title: Automation Consolidation & Hardening
brief: Multi-agent coordination protocol for chains that dispatch to agent teams. Stability testing under compaction pressure to verify chains survive context trimming. Chain regression tests to prevent automation regressions across releases.

units.title: Define multi-agent coordination protocol: chain-to-team dispatch, result aggregation, conflict resolution, budget splitting
Implement stability testing under compaction pressure: run all chains with simulated compaction at each step, verify state survival
Build chain regression test suite: golden-path tests for each automation chain, snapshot comparison, budget assertion
Final integration test: all chains end-to-end with entry router, failure recovery, compaction, telemetry, and agent coordination

exit_conditions: Multi-agent coordination protocol documented and implemented for team-dispatch chains
All chains stable under compaction pressure (zero state loss)
Regression test suite covers golden paths for all automation chains
Full integration test passes: router -> chain -> recovery -> telemetry
